timeline.tweet: Bloody hell. I have turned 43 today. Does that make me a pensioner in gay years?

Finally managed to bring my husband to the #ChurchillWarRooms in London. An incredible and humbling insight into the process of Government in the Second World War and understanding the man that is Winston Churchill.
19 years ago today, I met the man I would marry. Carl, you made me the happiest man alive xxx #LoveWins
We're fine. I'm now a System Administrator at XPO House of Fraser in Wellingborough. Still very much a geek. I've been playing Elite Dangerous on and off for a while. Where are you off to next?

Dear Colton. I am so sorry to hear of your loss and send you all the peace and love I can as I am sure all your fans do. Take care and know that there are many people thinking of you at this sad time.

Love, Simon has to be one of the best gay films of all time. It should be shown as part of any educational syllabus on coming to terms with being LGBTQ. Please support this film by seeing it at the cinema so the studios will continue to make these films. Love, Karl.
How are you, Mike. I am off to pastures new in 3 weeks time. Working for NHS England as an Information Analyst in Kettering. Onwards and upwards etc.

We kept it simple, but still had a fantastic time. Total cost was around £2500. (Includes registry office, afternoon tea for 40 and a disco for 100 with buffet) If you've got the funds, then go at it, but there's no need to start your marriage £35k in debt.
New job started.. Information Analyst for Northamptonshire NHS Foundation Trust in the Business Intelligence department. Wish me luck...
I loved home economics. The only guy in my school that year to take it for GCSE. It taught me a lot and inspired a lifelong love of cooking and baking. Every school should teach it.
Oh no. That's awful. So sorry for the loss of your fur baby. They give you so much joy, it hurts so hard when they go. (Sorry for coming across as Crazy Cat Man).

it is with a great sadness that I have to say that my gorgeous boy, Eric passed away on Wednesday. He was 20 years, 11 months old. Got him from Heydon in 2006. Loved us from day one. Catless for the first time in 18 years😢. Would love to adopt again soon.
